title: Skateboard with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Skateboard deck -->
  <path d='M12 60 Q12 52 22 52 L78 52 Q88 52 88 60 Q88 68 78 68 L22 68 Q12 68 12 60 Z' fill='#ff6b35'/>
  <!-- Deck top highlight -->
  <path d='M16 58 Q16 54 24 54 L76 54 Q84 54 84 58' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Deck bottom edge -->
  <path d='M16 62 Q16 66 24 66 L76 66 Q84 66 84 62' stroke='#c94a1c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Nose kick -->
  <path d='M88 60 Q94 56 92 48' stroke='#ff6b35' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail kick -->
  <path d='M12 60 Q6 56 8 48' stroke='#ff6b35' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Face - eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='58.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='58.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 64 Q50 70 58 64' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- Trucks -->
  <rect x='28' y='68' width='8' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#9aa3b5'/>
  <rect x='64' y='68' width='8' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#9aa3b5'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='7' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='7' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffb347'/>
</svg>
